Macau. Июль 2026. Casino GGR минус 8.4% год к году.

Версия для прессы - тайфуны. Прошли, но несерьёзно.

Настоящая причина - World Cup. Пока шёл турнир, VIP-игроки Sands China и MGM China предпочли трибуны столам.

MGM признал: спрос начал возвращаться ещё до финала.

Год назад этот сегмент считался неприкасаемым - слишком лоялен к столу, чтобы отвлекаться на футбол.

Один турнир показал: даже самый дорогой клиент в мире может просто не прийти.

На какой турнир у вас не заложена пауза в VIP-календаре?

linkedin_post.text:
LINKEDIN POST:

Three regulators. Three continents. The same 90 days.

On May 1, 2026, Sweden banned credit-funded gambling deposits outright - no credit cards, personal loans, overdrafts, or buy-now-pay-later. In the UK, the Gambling Levy Regulations (in force since April 2025) turned a discretionary industry contribution into a statutory charge that raised almost £120M in its first year, split across treatment, prevention, and research. In Victoria, Australia, slot machines now require a registered card with loss and time limits set before play even starts.

The Responsible Gambling Council's new report, "Evolving Expectations" - the first in its six-part Sector Signals series, published July 27 - lines these three markets up side by side. Different legal tools, same direction: what used to be a VIP program's internal judgment call is now a regulator's hard rule, enforced before the first spin.

For VIP operations, the read-through is simple. The operators still winning aren't the ones lobbying against these frameworks - they're the ones already running compliant-by-default programs that don't need a regulator to catch up with them.

If your VIP tier still relies on discretion instead of design, the window to fix that quietly is closing.
